standard.summary: （实验性）Lulynx 质量感知辅助 loss 族：频域纹理锚点（freq_texture）通过频域 Gram 矩阵约束纹理风格；Latent 锚点（latent_anchor）通过 EMA latent 参考约束生成稳定性。
standard.effect: freq_texture 有助于保持训练数据的特征纹理风格；latent_anchor 防止生成结果偏离 EMA 稳定版本过远（类似 EMA 蒸馏的 latent 版本）。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能，适合研究探索。对特定纹理风格 LoRA 有潜在收益。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。增加的辅助 loss 会改变训练动力学，不确定效果时不要开启。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) The Lulynx quality-aware auxiliary loss family: the frequency-domain texture anchor (freq_texture) constrains texture style through a frequency-domain Gram matrix; the latent anchor (latent_anchor) constrains generation stability against an EMA latent reference.
standard_en.effect: freq_texture helps hold on to the characteristic texture style of the training data; latent_anchor keeps the output from drifting too far from the stable EMA version (a latent-space counterpart of EMA distillation).
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature suited to research exploration. It may benefit a LoRA aimed at a specific texture style.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. The extra auxiliary loss changes the training dynamics, so do not enable it while you are unsure of the effect.

advanced.principle: freq_texture = 对特征图做 DCT + Gram 矩阵，计算频域风格距离；latent_anchor = EMA latent vs 当前 latent 的 L2 距离，权重 latent_anchor_weight 控制约束强度。
advanced.tradeoffs: 两种 loss 的权重需要仔细调整，过大会主导训练目标；过小则效果不明显。建议通过实验对比确定合适权重。

advanced_en.principle: freq_texture = DCT + Gram matrix on feature maps, computing a frequency-domain style distance; latent_anchor = L2 distance between the EMA latent and current latent, with latent_anchor_weight controlling constraint strength.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Both losses' weights need careful tuning: too large dominates the training objective, too small has no visible effect. Determine suitable weights experimentally.
